games.title: IRON TIDE
games.author: ghanimz
games.blurb: Build your own ship, buy jets for the hangar, and sink other fleets at sea. Earn credits, refit, sail again.

games.title: LAST CONVOY
games.author: ghanimz
games.blurb: Escort the fuel truck down Route 9. It is slow, it is loud, and everything on this road wants it.

games.title: RADIO TOWER
games.author: ghanimz
games.blurb: Hold the relay until dawn. Every wave is faster, and the tower is the only thing keeping the map alive.

games.title: PIT STOP PANIC
games.author: ghanimz
games.blurb: Patch the rig before the infected reach the bay. Tap the bolts, keep the hose moving, survive the wave.

games.title: SCRAPYARD RUN
games.author: ghanimz
games.blurb: One bag, one collapsing yard. Grab the best value per kilo and get out before it folds on you.

games.title: SIGNAL LOST
games.author: ghanimz
games.blurb: The dark only shows what your radio pings reveal. Find eight beacons before the battery gives out.
